findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant isolation for document reads
findings.body: Returning true unconditionally allows users to read documents belonging to any tenant. Any consumer relying on this exported authorization helper will permit cross-tenant data disclosure instead of enforcing tenant equality.

findings.title: [P1] Restore tenant ownership check
findings.body: This previously reported defect remains open after current-source revalidation. Evidence: Current src/access.ts:2 still returns true unconditionally; the full PR diff shows this replaces userTenant === documentTenant, so tenant ownership enforcement remains removed.
